mapper.sql: select u.user_id as engineer_id, u.user_id, e.employee_no, u.nick_name as real_name, u.sex, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, u.status, e.skill_level, e.specialties, e.join_date, ifnull(e.total_orders, 0) as total_orders, ifnull(e.completed_orders, 0) as completed_orders, ifnull(e.rating_avg, 0) as rating_avg, ifnull(e.pending_today, 0) as pending_today, u.avatar, u.create_time, e.last_login_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join zw_engineer_ext e on u.user_id = e.user_id
mapper.select: where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_key = 'zw_engineer' )

select w.work_order_id, w.order_no, w.title, w.status, w.create_time as dispatch_time, c.dept_name from zw_work_order w left join sys_dept c on w.customer_id = c.dept_id where w.assigned_to = #{engineerId} and w.del_flag = '0' order by w.create_time desc limit 20
